title: Matrix-Vector Dot Product
prompt:
A linear model needs one score for each feature row. Implement `matrix_vector_dot(matrix, vector)` using numeric Python lists.

`matrix` has shape `(rows, features)` and `vector` has length `features`. Return their matrix-vector product as a Python list with one value per row.

Reject empty inputs, ragged rows, or incompatible dimensions. An `assert` is sufficient; returning the legacy sentinel `-1` is also accepted.
